trust_decision.summary: How much <use>-driven expansion an untrusted SVG may cause is decided nowhere at the pinned commit: SVGObject.build_xref deep-copies the referenced, already-expanded group for every <use> (GraphicsContext.add_item clone=True), so nested fan-out grows exponentially; the fix adds a pre-pass (_check_svg_limits) plus a per-element budget (_record_resolved_elements) inside SVGObject, configurable through FPDF.svg_limits.

landing_point.why: The summary names SVG '<use>' expansion; build_xref is the only <use> handler and adds the cross-referenced group with a deep copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: SVGObject.__init__ / SVGObject.from_file (public API), reached by FPDF.image()
nested <image href=*.svg> rendered from an SVG passed to FPDF.image()
FPDF.image('file.svg' or Path) - preload_image str/Path branch, now re-raises FPDFException instead of wrapping in ValueError
FPDF.image() / HTML (fpdf/html.py:1182) / Template image (fpdf/template.py:576) / table cell image (fpdf/table.py:497)
SVG OpenType colour-font glyph rendering via FPDF.preload_glyph_image (fpdf/font_type_3.py:246)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fpdf/fpdf.py:5745 (preload_glyph_image, reached from SVG colour fonts at fpdf/font_type_3.py:246) and fpdf/text_region.py:301 (ImageParagraph)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Colour-font glyph SVGs and text_columns images look like separate features (fonts, text layout), not 'FPDF.image()'; and because SVGObject falls back to default limits, an unplumbed route is still bounded, so a solver can argue plumbing the configured limit there is unnecessary.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate <use>/<symbol> reuse (icon sprites, repeated shapes, symbols with viewBox scaling) and the existing double processing of <defs> in build_group must keep rendering; an over-strict count or a ban on repeated references breaks normal SVGs in the existing SVG test corpus.

O6_input_shapes: SVG text passed directly to SVGObject / SVGObject.from_file
SVG documents inside OpenType colour fonts (SVG table)

O7_producer.where: fpdf/svg.py:962-965 (update_xref stores the built GraphicsContext in cross_references; each <use> deep-copies it via fpdf/drawing.py:3631-3632)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Nested <image href='*.svg'> is re-parsed into a fresh SVGObject with its own budget on every rendered instance, so <use> fan-out of an <image> multiplies outer and inner limits instead of sharing one budget.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Nested SVG images are documented as unsupported (warning, nothing drawn) and need a local .svg file or remote URL, so it looks like a resource-access-policy concern, not <use> expansion.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, separate render-time class (SVGImage) reached only from drawing output; load path in fpdf/image_parsing.py:395-406

O8b_injection_room.sibling: clip-path='url(#id)' resolution that clones the referenced clip group per use instead of sharing it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: add_item defaults to clone=True; a maintainer adding <clipPath> group/<use> support would naturally reuse the cloning helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: <symbol> or a future <switch>/<pattern> container expanded outside build_group so it skips the per-element counter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The release changelog already records a follow-up 'count SVG <switch> elements in SVG complexity limits' (fix.diff:67), showing new containers get added without the counter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: gradient href inheritance (xlink:href between gradients) resolving recursively
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SVG spec allows gradient templates via href; the parser has no such support yet and a contributor adding it would likely recurse without a budget.

O9_family: Uncontrolled resource consumption / exponential entity (reference) expansion in SVG parsing (CWE-400/770)

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . (setuptools/pyproject), pytest; deps fonttools, defusedxml, Pillow
O10_build.project_tests: test/svg/test_svg.py, test/svg/parameters.py (large SVG fixture corpus), test/svg/test_svg_gradients.py; fix adds test/svg/test_svg_limits.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a recursion-depth counter to build_xref only, which still allows exponential fan-out (e.g. depth 20, fan-out 2) and ignores total resolved-element count.

out_of_scope_notes: preload_image only treats str inputs as SVG when they end in '.svg' (fpdf/image_parsing.py:395); data: URIs with SVG go to the raster path - unrelated to expansion.
Default ResourceAccessPolicy allows LOCAL_FILES|REMOTE_PUBLIC (fpdf/enums.py:46), relevant to nested SVG image loading but a separate protection.
unverified: Resource-exhaustion advisories never produced a hard task in lessons-v2 (0 of 7); this host is DoS-only, treat as a strong negative even though no formal red flag applies.

O8 nested-SVG-image multiplication is inferred from reading (no per-render cache for vector images seen in preload_image); not run. Exploitability needs an attacker-chosen local .svg path or remote URL.

Since SVGObject defaults to SVGLimits() when none is passed (fix.diff:478), unplumbed entry points stay bounded after the fix; the plumbing sites only matter if hidden tests check user-configured FPDF.svg_limits, which the report would have to introduce. This weakens Pattern A, so pattern_fit is B only.
